invariants: INV-GOV-GENESIS-IMMUTABLE: Genesis anchor payload and file hash must never be modified in-place or deleted.
INV-GOV-GENESIS-ANCESTRY: All task capsules and attestations must trace root ancestry back to the genesis anchor.

provisions.statement: Every command capsule must declare the exact path and SHA-256 hash of genesis.json.
CI integrity checks must verify genesis anchor existence, regular file semantics, and SHA-256 match on every commit.

scope: Immutable cryptographic genesis anchoring, repository lineage root tracking, and origin verification.
title: Synthesis Genesis Anchor and Lineage Root Contract
